cases.explain: «Бедный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

cases.explain: «непомерными процентами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

cases.explain: «собственных глазах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

cases.explain: «Жестокий правитель» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

cases.explain: «Верный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

cases.explain: «Жадный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
